name: OmaStamp
author: Dorneles
description: Overlay and stamp custom logos, vector crests, and typographic watermarks directly over the desktop background wallpaper.

barWidget.description: Desktop background logo and watermark stamp studio

schema.label: Enable Stamp Overlay
schema.description: Show or hide the desktop logo overlay.

schema.label: Stamp Mode
schema.description: Source of the stamp: built-in preset vector, custom image file, or text monogram.

schema.label: Preset Logo
schema.description: Select from bundled high-resolution vector insignia.

schema.label: Screen Position
schema.description: Anchor placement on the desktop screen.

schema.label: Logo Size (px)
schema.description: Size in pixels of the rendered stamp.

schema.label: Opacity Percentage (0-100%)
schema.description: Watermark transparency level on the background.

schema.label: Color Tint Mode
schema.description: How the stamp should be colored: follow dynamic theme accent, text color, original colors, or custom.

schema.label: Custom Hex Color
schema.description: Custom color when tintMode is set to 'custom'.

schema.label: Rotation Angle (Degrees)
schema.description: Angle to rotate the logo (e.g. -15° or 45° for slanted watermark).

schema.label: Edge Margin / Padding (px)
schema.description: Distance in pixels from the screen edges.

schema.label: Subtle Drop Shadow
schema.description: Add subtle depth shadow behind the logo.

schema.label: Custom Image Path
schema.description: Absolute path to custom SVG, PNG, JPG or WebP file.

schema.label: Watermark Text
schema.description: Text displayed when mode is set to 'text'.

schema.label: Primary Screen Only
schema.description: Show stamp only on the main display instead of all connected monitors.
